parameter.expression: SELECT CODEMP AS VALUE, CODEMP || ' - ' || NOMEFANTASIA AS LABEL FROM TSIEMP WHERE CODEMP <> 501 ORDER BY CODEMP

grid.expression: SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.CODPARC || ' - ' || PAR.NOMEPARC AS PARCEIRO, SUM(ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC) AS VLRCTB, SUM(CASE WHEN CAB.ISSRETIDO = 'S' THEN CAB.VLRISS ELSE 0 END) + (SELECT NVL(SUM(IMP.VALOR), 0) FROM TGFIMN IMP WHERE IMP.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND IMP.TIPOIMPOSTO = 4) AS ISSRETIDO, SUM(CASE WHEN CAB.IRFRETIDO = 'S' THEN CAB.VLRIRF ELSE 0 END) + (SELECT NVL(SUM(IMP.VALOR), 0) FROM TGFIMN IMP WHERE IMP.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND IMP.TIPOIMPOSTO = 8) AS IRFRETIDO, ((SELECT NVL(SUM(DIN.VALOR), 0) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND DIN.CODIMP = 5 AND DIN.TIPO = -1) + (SELECT NVL(SUM(IMP.VALOR), 0) FROM TGFIMN IMP WHERE IMP.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND IMP.TIPOIMPOSTO = 5)) AS INSSRETIDO, ((SELECT NVL(SUM(IMP.VALOR), 0) FROM TGFIMN IMP WHERE IMP.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND IMP.TIPOIMPOSTO = 6) + (SELECT NVL(SUM(IMP.VALOR), 0) FROM TGFIMN IMP WHERE IMP.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND IMP.TIPOIMPOSTO = 7) + (SELECT NVL(SUM(IMP.VALOR), 0) FROM TGFIMN IMP WHERE IMP.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND IMP.TIPOIMPOSTO = 9)) AS PCCRETIDO, (SELECT NVL(SUM(IMP.VALOR), 0) FROM TGFIMN IMP WHERE IMP.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND IMP.TIPOIMPOSTO = 6) AS PISRETIDO, (SELECT NVL(SUM(IMP.VALOR), 0) FROM TGFIMN IMP WHERE IMP.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND IMP.TIPOIMPOSTO = 7) AS COFINSRETIDO, (SELECT NVL(SUM(IMP.VALOR), 0) FROM TGFIMN IMP WHERE IMP.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND IMP.TIPOIMPOSTO = 9) AS CSLLRETIDO, CAB.VLRNOTA FROM TGFCAB CAB, TGFPAR PAR, TGFITE ITE, TGFTOP OPE WHERE CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND CAB.CODTIPOPER = OPE.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = OPE.DHALTER AND OPE.ATUALLIVISS = 'E' AND CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND CAB.CODEMP <> 501 AND CAB.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND CAB.DTENTSAI BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND (CAB.CODPARC IN :CABCODPARC OR :CABCODPARC IS NULL) GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.CODPARC, PAR.NOMEPARC, CAB.VLRNOTA ORDER BY 3, 2
